Thepha umbala kokhiye, bese uthepha izikwele ofuna ukuzigcwalisa ngawo.
Sebenzisa umbala ofana nenombolo, noma noma yimuphi umbala oyithandayo. Zombili zilungile.
Thepha “Gcwalisa ngezinombolo” ngezikwele ezingenalutho, “Sula” ukuqala igridi kabusha, noma “Esinye isithombe” ngesinye.
tips: Hlalani eceleni nithathe izinyathelo ngokuphendukana: omunye akhethe umbala, omunye athephe isikwele.
Xoxani ngemibala: “Ngiyayithanda eluhlaza.” Asidingeki ukuthi nichaze ukuthi isithombe sizoba yini.
Esikrinini esincane igridi ye-8 ngo-8 iskrola ngakolunye uhlangothi ngaphakathi kwebhokisi yayo. Izikwele zihlala zinosayizi ophathekayo.
Inguqulo yephepha nayo isebenza ngopensile etafuleni elisecaleni kombhede.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho iwashi, amaphuzu, isibali-zinyathelo noma ukulahlekelwa. Ungamisa noma nini, futhi ukumisa uphakathi nendawo kuyindlela enhle yokuqeda.

faq.q: Kuyini uma ngisebenzisa umbala ohlukile kunenombolo?
faq.a: Akukho okwenzekayo, futhi yileyo ngqikithi. Noma yimuphi umbala ungafakwa kunoma iyiphi isikwele, futhi umdlalo awusho lutho ngalokho. Lapho isikwele ngasinye sinombala wenombolo yaso, umdlalo uyasho ngobumnene, futhi isithombe ngemibala yakho siyanele ngokufanayo.

faq.q: Ingabe abantu abanobuthakathaka bokubona imibala bangahlukanisa imibala emine?
faq.a: Yakhethwa ukuze kube njalo. Umbala ngamunye unenombolo, igama elibhaliwe nesimo sawo esincane, ngakho umbala awusoze waba yindlela yodwa yokuwahlukanisa. Imibala emine ihlolwe ngokulingisa ubuthakathaka bokubona okubomvu nokuluhlaza, nobuthakathaka bokubona okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nokuphuzi, futhi nokukhanya kwawo kuyahluka. Umuntu onobuthakathaka bokubona akakawazami, ngakho sicela usitshele uma amabili efana.

faq.q: Ingabe izikwele zinkulu ngokwanele ngokuthuthumela noma isikrini esincane?
faq.a: Isikwele ngasinye sinobubanzi bamapikseli angu-48 ubuncane, nangu-56 egridini ye-4 ngo-4. Uma igridi ibanzi kakhulu esikrinini, iskrola ngakolunye uhlangothi ngaphakathi kwebhokisi yayo kunokuthi incishiswe izikwele.
Yebo. Ishidi elilodwa linegridi enezinombolo nokhiye wemibala emine namagama ayo. Gcwalisa isikwele ngasinye ngopensile wombala ofana nenombolo yaso, noma noma yimuphi umbala oyithandayo.
Yebo, ayikhokhelwa, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisela noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu efonini, ethebhulethini noma kukhompyutha.

pattern-maker.name: Umenzi wephethini
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Umenzi wephethini: Dizayina Ithayili Uphrinte Iphethini
pattern-maker.description: Shintsha izikwele zethayili elincane ubone liphindeka libe yiphethini eliseceleni, ngemibala emine ngayinye inegama nesimo sayo. Akukho sikhathi noma amaphuzu. Kuyamahhala ukudlala nokuphrinta.
pattern-maker.short: Shintsha izikwele zethayili elincane ubone liphindeka libe yiphethini.
pattern-maker.players: Abantu abangu-1 noma aba-2, eceleni komunye nomunye
pattern-maker.intro: Ithayili elincane lezikwele ezi-3 ngo-3, noma ezi-4 ngo-4 uma uthanda, nasecaleni kwalo “iphethini yakho”: ithayili elifanayo liphindwa libe yibhloko. Thepha isikwele uzeshintshele emibaleni emine elandelayo, ngayinye inegama nesimo sayo elibhaliwe. Iphethini eseceleni yeshintsha ngokushesha. Akukho iphethini elungile, futhi akukho okulondolozwayo noma okuthunyelwayo. “Phrinta iphethini yami” ibeka iphethini ephindiwe ekhasini elilodwa ukuze uyigcine, uyidwebe noma uyinikeze.
howTo: Bheka ithayili nephethini yakho eseceleni kwalo. Ngamathayili afanayo, aphindiwe.
Thepha isikwele. Siyashintsha sibe umbala olandelayo emgqeni wemibala emine okhiye phezulu.
Qhubeka uthepha izikwele kuze kube yiphethini elibukeka ngendlela ofisa ngayo. Noma iyiphi iphethini iyinhle.
Thepha “Ngimangaze” ithayili elisha, noma “Qala kabusha” elisha. “Buyisela” ibuyisela ithayili obenalo.
Thepha “Phrinta iphethini yami” uma uyifuna ephepheni, noma thepha “Phumula” ukuze uyeke.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Yerisa ngamazwi: "Lokhu kufana nentwala." Akudingeki utshele igama lalo lonke.
Zama leli thayela ngemibala emibili kuphela, bese uzama futhi ngayo yonke imibala emine.
Uma iphepha lisetshenziswa, iphathini ingadayiswa ngamapensela, isikwe ibe yizicucu zekhadi, noma isetshenziselwe ukufaka isipho esincane.

Cha. Ithayela lakho lihlala kule khasi kuphela. Alilondolozwa, alilayishwa noma libalwe, futhi linyamalala uma uvala ikhasi. Uma ufuna ukugcina iphathini, yiphrinte.

faq.q: Yini uma uthinta isikwele esingalungile noma usule ithayela ngephutha?
faq.a: Akukho sikwele esingalungile: thinta futhi ukuze uye embaleni olandelayo. Ngemva kwe-"Qala kabusha" noma "Mangaza ngakho", "Buyisela" iletha ithayela ebebilo.

faq.q: Ingabe abantu abanobuthakathaka bokubona imibala bayakwazi ukuhlukanisa lezi zimbala ezine?
faq.a: Zakhethwa ukuze zenze lokho. Umbala ngamunye unegama elibhaliwe kanye nesimo sawo esincane esikhethekile kusikwele ngasinye, ngakho umbala awusoze ube yindlela eyodwa yokuhlukanisa. Imibala ezine ihlolwe ngokulingisa ukungaboni kahle imibala okubomvu-okuluhlaza nokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka-okwesibhakabhaka. Umuntu onobuthakathaka bokubona imibala akakayizami, ngakho sicela usitshele uma imbili ifana.

faq.q: Ingabe izikwele zinkulu ngokwanele ngenxa yokuzamazama kwesandla noma isikrini esincane?
faq.a: Isikwele ngasinye singamapikseli angu-56 ubukhulu ubuncane. Uma ithayela lilikhulu kakhulu esikrinini,ligudluka ngokuthe xaxa phakathi kwebhokisi lalo kunokuba lincishiswe izikwele.
Yebo. "Phrinta iphathini yami" iphrinta iphathini oyenzile ekhasini elilodwa, ibonisa imibala ezine namagama ayo, ilungile nasemnyama nomhlophe ngoba umbala ngamunye unesimo sawo.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu efonini, ethebulethini noma ekhompyutheni.

drawing-duet.name: Drawing duet
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Picture
drawing-duet.h1: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Sheet
drawing-duet.description: Two people take turns drawing lines on one shared canvas, each in a color of their own. Nobody scores or wins, and the picture can be saved or printed. Free to play, with no account.
drawing-duet.short: Take turns drawing one shared picture with someone beside you.
drawing-duet.intro: One canvas, two people. Each of you picks a color, and each color has its own written name. You take turns: draw one line or shape, then pass the pen. Either of you may pass at any time. There is no right picture and no score. Save the picture to your device if you like it, or print the paper version: one sheet, two pens.
howTo: Each of you picks a color. The banner says whose turn it is, with that person's color by name.
Draw one line or shape with a finger, a mouse or a pen. Or use the arrow keys and Space to draw without a pointer.
When you are ready, tap "Pass the pen". Either of you may pass at any time.
Tap "Take back my last line" to remove the newest line of the person whose turn it is.
Tap "Save picture" to make a picture file on this device, or "Print the paper version" for one sheet and two pens.
tips: Sit side by side and talk as you draw: "I will add a sun in the corner."
Start with a dot, a line or a simple shape, and let the other person answer it.
Nobody has to draw a picture of anything. A pattern of lines is just as good as a scene.
If you want to stop, tap "Done for now". Your picture is not kept after you leave the page unless you save it.

faq.q: Is there a winner or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no winner, no score, no timer and no count of turns. There is no right picture, and nothing is ranked or compared.

faq.q: Is the picture saved or sent?
faq.a: No, nothing is sent anywhere. The picture stays on this page until you close it. If you tap Save picture, a file is made on your device for you to download. Nothing is uploaded.

faq.q: Can I take back a line?
faq.a: Yes. "Take back my last line" removes the newest line of the person whose turn it is. "Start again" clears the sheet, and "Put it back" brings the lines back, one step only.

faq.q: Can I use this without a mouse or touch screen?
faq.a: Yes. When the drawing has focus, the arrow keys move a pen dot, and the Space key puts the pen down or up. The screen says "Pen down" or "Pen up" each time.

faq.q: What colors are they, and can people with color-blindness tell them apart?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green and purple, the same four colors used in our other picture games. Each has a written name, and the names show beside the turn. The colors were checked with simulations of common color-vision differences, but a person with color-vision differences has not yet tried them.
Yes. "Print the paper version" prints one sheet with the rules on it and a large blank frame to draw in, for two people with two pens. It works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, ikhululekile, futhi akudingeki ubhalise, udale i-akhawunti noma ukhiphe lutho. Isebenza ku-webhu ku-ifoni, ku-ithebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

build-together.name: Build together
build-together.seoTitle: Build Together: Two People Build One Pattern
build-together.h1: Build Together: Two People, One Grid
build-together.description: Two people take turns to put a piece in a shared grid until it is full, each with a color of their own that has a name and a shape. Nobody wins, and there is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
build-together.short: Take turns with someone beside you to fill one shared grid.
build-together.intro: A shared grid of 4 by 4 places, or 3 by 3 if you like. Each of you picks a color, and each color has its own written name and shape. You take turns: on your turn, tap an empty place to put your piece there. When every place has a piece, the picture is built together. There is no winner, because you make it as a pair, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print the grid" puts an empty grid on one page so you can build with two pencils.
howTo: Each of you picks a color. A color the other person has is marked "In use".
The first person goes first. The screen says whose turn it is and which color is theirs.
Tap an empty place to put your piece there. The turn passes to the other person.
If you would rather not place a piece, tap "Pass". Either of you may pass at any time.
When every place has a piece, you have built the picture together. Tap "Start again" to build another, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Sit side by side so you can both see and reach the screen. Talk as you go: "I will put mine next to yours."
Try to build a pattern, stripes, a checkerboard or a border, or just place pieces anywhere you like. Both are fine.
A child or a person who tires easily can pass as often as they like. The picture is still built together.
On paper, each person uses one pencil and draws their own shape in the empty squares.

faq.q: Is there a winner, a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no winner, because you build one picture together. There is no clock, score, count of pieces or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything we make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The grid stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page. If you would like to keep it, print the grid and build on paper.

faq.q: What if I put a piece in the wrong place?
faq.a: There is no wrong place. Tap "Take back the last piece" and the turn goes back to you. You can take back one step at a time, and a pass can be taken back too.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each piece, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the places big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every place is at least 56 pixels across. If the grid is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the places.
Yes. "Print the grid" prints an empty grid on one page with the two colors and their names, to build with two pencils. It works in black and white because every color has its own shape.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

seated-toss.name: Seated toss tally
seated-toss.seoTitle: Seated Toss Tally: a Bean-Bag Game for Two
seated-toss.h1: Seated Toss Tally: Toss Together at a Table
seated-toss.description: Two people at a table take turns tossing a soft bean bag into a big target and keep the tally on paper. Nothing is timed or scored. Free to print.
seated-toss.short: Take turns tossing a bean bag at a big target, with the tally on paper.
seated-toss.intro: A calm tossing game for two people sitting at a table. You lay a printed target on the table and take turns tossing a soft bean bag, or a rolled-up sock, so that it lands on the rings. Each of you keeps a tally by ticking boxes on paper, and you look at the ticks together when you stop. Nothing is timed, nothing is added up on screen, and nothing is saved or sent. Please read the safety notes first: small fillings are a choking hazard.
howTo: Read the safety notes. Choose a bag with a sewn-shut cover, or roll up a clean sock.
Tap "Print the target and tally sheet" and lay the sheet flat on the table between you.
Sit comfortably, one on each side, and take turns with one gentle toss each. Anyone may pass.
When a toss lands in a ring, tick a box in your column, on the row for that ring.
Look at the ticks together when you stop, or tap Rest to pause.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "Hiyo ibhegi elithambile." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

Kungaba kuphephile, uma kwenziwa ngokucophelela. Sebenzisa isikhwama esinesivalo esishelelwe ngokuphelele noma isokisi elisongiwe, hhayi imbewu, irayisi noma izinto ezincane ezingaphakathi, ezingaba yingozi yokuqothuka ngomphimbo kubantwana abancane nakunoma ubani ofaka izinto emlonyeni. Hlala phansi, uphonse kancane ngasetafuleni, ungaphonseli ebusweni, futhi gcina umuntu omdala eseduze.

faq.q: Ukhona yini okubalwayo noma okulondolozwayo esikrinini?
faq.a: Cha. Ukubalwa kwenziwa kuphepha kuphela, ezibhokisini onizibhalisa ngazo ngokwenu. Ikhasi aligcini ukubala noma isikhathi, futhi akukho okulondolozwayo noma okuthunyelwayo.

faq.q: Kuthini uma umuntu engakwazi ukuphonsa, noma isikhwama singena ngaphandle kweshidi?
faq.a: Noma ubani angadlulisa ithuba, futhi isikhwama esiwele ngaphandle keshidi siyathathwa sibe yithuba elilandelayo. Akukho okubalwa ngaso.

Ikhasi elilodwa: isibhamu esikhulu esinemibuthano yayo emithathu eqanjwe ngokuthi Eduze, Phakathi kanye Kude, itafula elinekholomu yomuntu ngamunye kanye nomugqa wamabhokisi amancane okunzima ukuze kubhalwe ibhokisi ngalinye lombuthano, kanye nomugqa wezeluleko zokuphepha. Amagama abhalwe emibuthanweni, ngakho lisebenza ngomhlophe nomnyama.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza ebhrawuzeni yewebhu efonini, ethebhulethini noma ekhompyutheni.

seasonal-pack.name: Iphakheji lezithombe zezikhathi zonyaka
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Iphakheji Lezithombe Zezikhathi Zonyaka: Izithombe Zephepha Ezinyathelisekayo
seasonal-pack.h1: Iphakheji Lezithombe Zezikhathi Zonyaka: Izithombe Ezintathu Zephepha Ngenyanga Ngayinye
seasonal-pack.description: Izithombe ezintathu ezincane ezinyathelisekayo zanoma yiyiphi inyanga yonyaka: hlanganisa izibonelo, ujikelezise into ehlukile, uphinde uphendule isithombe ngemibala. Ikhasi livula le nyanga, noma unganyula enye, noma uthathe usuku lokuphumula. Ukunyathelisa kuyamahhala.
seasonal-pack.short: Izithombe ezintathu ezinyathelisekayo zenyanga oyikhethayo, noma usuku lokuphumula.
seasonal-pack.players: Zonke izinga lobudala, wedwa noma ndawonye
seasonal-pack.intro: Khetha inyanga, bese ikhasi libonisa izithombe ezintathu ezincane zephepha ezithathwe ezithombeni zalelo nyanga: imigqa emibili yokuxhumanisa ngemigqa, uhlu lwezithombe ezine lokujikelezisa eyehlukile, kanye nesithombe sokuphendula ngemibala. Ikhasi livula inyanga yamanje yedivayisi yakho. Unyathelisa ikhasi elilodwa, bese wenza eyodwa, emibili noma zombathathu, ngesivinini sakho. Khetha "Namuhla kungusuku lokuphumula" esikhundleni salokho, khona-ke akukho okufanele wenze.
howTo: Khetha inyanga, noma khetha "Namuhla kungusuku lokuphumula".
Bheka izithombe ezintathu, bese uthepha "Nyathelisa iphakheji yalenyanga".
Wenza eyodwa, emibili noma zombathathu, ngesivinini sakho.
Xhumanisa izithombe ezifanayo ngomugqa, ujikelezise eyehlukile, bese uphendula isithombe esikhulu ngemibala.
Yima noma nini lapho ufuna khona. Usuku lokuphumula nalo lulungile.
tips: Qala ngombukiso ozwakala ulula namuhla. Eyodwa iyanele.
Shono igama lesithombe ngasinye ngokuzwakalayo, uma kusiza.
Sebenzisa amakhilayoni noma amapensela. Noma yimiphi imibala ilungile.
Gcina ikhasi ngesikhathi esilandelayo, noma liyeke.

faq.q: Kuthini uma kungekho muntu ofuna izithombe namuhla?
faq.a: Khetha "Namuhla kungusuku lokuphumula". Ikhasi bese libonisa umugqa owodwa othulile, futhi akukho okufanele ukunyathelise noma ukwenze.

Yebo, kuyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza ebhrawuzeni yewebhu efonini, ethebhulethini noma ekhompyutheni.

decorate-a-card.name: Hlobisa ikhadi ndawonye
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Hlobisa Ikhadi Ndawonye: Ikhadi Lokubonga Elinyathelisekayo
decorate-a-card.h1: Hlobisa Ikhadi Ndawonye: Yenzele Umuntu Othile Elilodwa
decorate-a-card.description: Abantu ababili bahlobisa ikhadi lokubonga elinyathelisiwe lokuzalwa, ukubonga noma ngenxa yokuthi nje bekufanele, bese kuthi ngemuva kwalo babhale umyalezo ndawonye. Amakhilayoni noma amapeni kuphela. Akukho sikhathi noma umphumela. Ukunyathelisa kuyamahhala.
decorate-a-card.intro: Umdlalo wokwenza ozolile wabantu ababili abahlala badedelene. Unyathelisa ishidi elilodwa, eligoqwa libe yikhadi. Khetha isizathu, njengokuzalwa noma ukubonga, bese uhlobisa ingaphambili ngokuzungeze amagama alo. Bese ubhala umyalezo ngemuva, ndawonye noma omunye abhale lokho okushiwo ngumunye. Sebenzisa amakhilayoni, amapensela ayimibala noma amapeni. Akukho khadi elilungile ngokuphelele, futhi akukho okulinganiswa isikhathi, okuphethwe ngamaphoyinti noma okuthunyelwa.
howTo: Chagela okuthile, bese uthepha i-"Print the card".
Goqa ishidi phakathi ngomugqa oqoshiwe, ukuze uhlangothi lwangaphambili lube ngaphandle.
Omunye umuntu uhlobisa uhlangothi lwangaphambili, omunye uhlobise uhlangothi lwangemuva, noma nithatha izinyathelo ngokuhlobisa uhlangothi lunye.
Bhalani umyalezo ndawonye. Omunye angabhala kuyilapho omunye esho amagama.
Yima noma nini lapho ufisa khona. Ikhadi elilula lihle njengelinemininingwane.
tips: Qala ngamagama aphezulu, bese wengeza amahlamvu, izinkanyezi noma amachashaza ozungezile, kancane kancane.
Uma umuntu ethanda ukungadweba, angakhetha imibala noma abhale umyalezo.
Tshela okuthandayo ezindaweni ezenziwe ngumuntu omunye, esikhundleni sokuthi zinhle yini.
Gcina ikhadi lapho linganikezwa khona, noma nje liyeke etafuleni okwamanje.

faq.q: Ukhona yini okubalwa, okwahlulelwa noma okugcinwa esikrinini?

conversation-cards.intro: Ikhadi ngalinye lihlanganisa isithombe esijwayelekile nesimemo esivulekile sokukhuluma, njengokuthi “Yiluphi uhlobo lwezulu oluthandayo?” Azikho izimpendulo ezifanele futhi akukho lutho okufanele lukhunjulwe. Khethani indikimba noma niwaxube wonke.

photo-pairs.intro: Khetha izithombe zomndeni wakho ezi-2 kuya kwezi-6 ezisefonini, othebhulethini noma ekhompyutheni yakho, zibe umdlalo wokuhlanganisa onezithombe ezinkulu nezibonakalayo. picture-bingo.name: I-bingo yezithombe
picture-bingo.description: Ibingo yezithombe yamahhala eshicilelwayo yemindeni, amaqembu abantu abadala kanye nezindawo zokunakekelwa. Izithombe ezinkulu namagama, izikwele ezi-9 noma ezi-16, kanye nomcengi omkhulu osekrinini.
picture-bingo.short: Amakhadi e-bingo yezithombe aphrintekayo nomsakazi wesikrini esikhulu wamaqembu.
picture-bingo.intro: I-bingo yakudala enezithombe esikhundleni sezinombolo, ngakho akekho odinga ukufunda okuncane. Phrintani isethi yamakhadi ahlukile, bese nisebenzisa umsakazi osesikrinini ukukhombisa isithombe ngasinye sikhulu kuthelevishini, kulaptop noma kuthebhulethi.
howTo: Khethani izikwele ezi-9 noma ezi-16 ekhadini ngalinye nokuthi bangaki abadlali.
Thintani “Phrinta amakhadi”. Ikhadi ngalinye lihlukile.
Vulani umsakazi esikrinini esikhulu. Thintani “Isithombe esilandelayo” ukukhombisa isithombe ngasinye negama laso.
Abadlali bamboza isithombe esifanayo ekhadini labo ngemali, inkinobho noma uphawu.
Wonke ogcwalisa umugqa, noma ikhadi lonke, uthola ukwamukelwa ngenjabulo. Alikho oyehlulwayo kule nguqulo: qhubekani nidlala kuze wonke umuntu abe nomugqa.
tips: Sebenzisani amathokheni amakhulu afana nezivalo zamabhodlela. Izinkinobho ezincane zingaba nzima ukuziphakamisa.
Qambani igama lesithombe nisho okuthile ngaso: “Isikebhe. Ubani osake waphuma ngesikebhe?”
Hlalisani abantu abanobunzima bokubona eduze kakhulu nesikrini, futhi nihlanganise abasizi nabadlali ababadingayo.
Izikwele eziyisishiyagalolunye zanele amaqembu amaningi. Gcinani isikhathi cishe imizuzu engama-20 kuya kwengama-30.

faq.q: Ngiyiqhuba kanjani i-bingo yezithombe ekhaya lokunakekela?
faq.a: Phrintani ikhadi elilodwa ngomdlali ngamunye, nibeke umsakazi esikrinini esikhulu enaso, bese nibiza izithombe kancane, niqamba ngasinye. Dlalani kuze wonke umuntu abe nomugqa, ukuze akekho oshiywa.
Yebo. Phrintani amakhadi amaningi njengoba nidinga, kaningi njengoba nithanda, ukusetshenziswa komuntu siqu noma kweqembu.
Yebo. Isikwele ngasinye siyisithombe esikhulu, negama laso ngezansi kwalabo abathanda amagama.

picnic-planner.name: Umhleli wepikiniki
picnic-planner.h1: Umhleli Wepikiniki: Khetha Izithombe, Bese Uzihlanganisa
picnic-planner.description: Khetha izithombe zokudla nezinto zokwenza zepikiniki, bese udlala umdlalo wokuhlanganisa oyinhlanganisela yalezo zithombe. Akukho sikhathi esilinganiswayo. Mahhala ukudlala nokushicilela.
picnic-planner.short: Khetha izithombe zokudla nezokuphuma zepikiniki, bese uzihlanganisa.
picnic-planner.intro: Thepha izithombe zokudla nezinto zokwenza ukuze uzifake esitsheni sepikiniki, esingabamba kuze kufike kwezi-6. Umusho ngamagama ushoyo ukuthi yini esitsheni, njengalo "Ipikiniki lethu: isinkwa, ushizi, iapula nesikhwepha." Bese uthepha "Masidlale ngepikiniki lethu" ukuze uthole umdlalo wokuhlanganisa onomoya omnene owenziwe ngezithombe ezikhethiwe. Izithombe ziyahlala zibonakala, futhi akukho sikhathi, amaphuzu noma ukugcinwa. "Shicilela uhlu lwepikiniki lethu" ushicilela uhlu lokuhlola lwalokho okukhethiwe, nebhokisi lokuhlola kuzo zonke izinto ezizopakishwa.
howTo: Thepha isithombe sokudla noma into yokwenza. Siya esitsheni.
Thepha isithombe esisesitsheni ukuze usikhiphe futhi.
Khetha okungenani izinto ezi-2, bese uthepha "Masidlale ngepikiniki lethu".
Thepha izithombe ezi-2 ezifanayo. Izithombe ziyahlala zibonakala, ngakho akudingeki ukukhumbula lutho.
Thepha "Shicilela uhlu lwepikiniki lethu" ukuze uthole uhlu lokuhlola lwephepha olungathatha nawe.

scrapbook.name: Leyo ncwadi yezikhumbuzo
scrapbook.seoTitle: Incwadi Yezikhumbuzo: Phendulela Izithombe Zomndeni Ndawonye, Ikhasi Ngekhasi
scrapbook.h1: Incwadi Yezikhumbuzo: Engeza Izithombe Nezichasiselo Zakho, Bese Uphendulela Amakhasi
scrapbook.description: Khetha izithombe zomndeni wakho ezi-2 kuya kwezi-12 esidivayisini sakho, bese uziphendulela njengencwadi, namagama ambalwa ngaphansi kwesithombe ngasinye. Akulayishwa lutho. Mahhala ukushicilela.
scrapbook.short: Phendulela izithombe zomndeni wakho ndawonye, njengencwadi.
scrapbook.intro: Khetha izithombe zakho ezi-2 kuya kwezi-12 kule divayisi. Isithombe ngasinye siba yikhasi elilodwa lencwadi, likhulu ngokwanele ukuze libonakale, negama elingeke elingaphansi kwalo. Phendula amakhasi ngamaqhosha noma ngamakhiye egxa. Sebenzisa "Bukani ndawonye" ukuze nihlale ecaleni komunye nomunye nezithombe namagama kuphela. Izithombe zakho zihlala kule divayisi. Azilayishwa noma azigcinwa, futhi incwadi iyanyamalala uma uvala ikhasi. "Shicilela incwadi yezikhumbuzo" ushicilela isithombe kanye namagama aso ekhasini ngalinye, kanye nezinombolo zamakhasi.
howTo: Thepha "Khetha izithombe" bese ukhetha izithombe ezi-2 kuya kwezi-12. Buza ngaphambi kokusebenzisa isithombe somuntu ongakwazi ukuvuma.
Phendula amakhasi nge-"Ikhasi eledlule" ne-"Ikhasi elilandelayo", noma ngamakhiye egxa angakwesobunxele nakwesokudla.
Engeza amagama ambalwa ngaphansi kwesithombe uma uthanda. Sebenzisa "Hambisa ngaphambili" noma "Hambisa ngemuva" ukuguqula ukuhleleka.
Thepha "Bukani ndawonye" ukuze ufihle izilawuli zokuhlela ubukele incwadi ecaleni komunye nomunye.
Thepha "Shicilela incwadi yezikhumbuzo" ukuze uthole ikhophi yephepha, noma "Sula incwadi" lapho usuqedile. Akukho okugcinwa.
tips: Vyberte fotky šťastných a známých věcí: zahrada, zvíře, oblíbené místo. Při otáčení každé stránky o ní mluvte.
Nechte člověka říct pár slov ke každé stránce, i jediné slovo, a zapište je přesně tak, jak je řekne.
Na papíře se vytištěné stránky mohou uložit do složky a rodina kolem nich může přidat vlastní fotky a poznámky.

faq.q: Je tu časovač, skóre nebo vítěz?
faq.a: Ne. Nic se neměří časem, nebere se do skóre ani nepočítá a nikdo nevyhrává. Číslo stránky tu jen slouží k tomu, abyste věděli, kde v knize jste.

faq.q: Ukládají se, nahrávají nebo odesílají naše fotky nebo popisky?
faq.a: Ne. Fotky čte jen tato stránka a nikam se nenahrávají, neukládají ani neposílají. Popisky zůstávají jen po dobu, kdy je stránka otevřená. Když stránku zavřete, kniha zmizí.
Ano. Tlačítko „Vytisknout album“ vytiskne na každou stránku jednu fotku s popiskem a čísly stránek. V dialogu tisku zvolte formát A4 nebo US Letter.

faq.q: Je to zdarma a musím se registrovat?
faq.a: Ano, je to zdarma a není potřeba účet, registrace ani stahování. Funguje ve webovém prohlížeči v telefonu, tabletu nebo počítači.

collage-board.name: Kolážová tabule
collage-board.seoTitle: Kolážová tabule: Dva lidé střídavě kladou obrázky
collage-board.h1: Kolážová tabule: Střídavě kladení obrázků na jednu tabuli
collage-board.description: Dva lidé se střídají a kladou vystřižené obrázky na jednu společnou tabuli. Klepněte na výstřižek a potom na prázdné místo. Bez časomíry a skóre. Hra i tisk jsou zdarma.
collage-board.short: Střídavě kladte obrázky na jednu společnou tabuli.
collage-board.intro: Dva lidé sedí vedle sebe u jedné tabule s dvanácti místy a zásobníku s osmi vystřiženými obrázky. Klepněte na výstřižek a potom na prázdné místo, obrázek se tam položí. Tah pak přechází na druhou osobu. Obrázky každé osoby mají vlastní tvar, kruh nebo čtverec, takže tabule ukazuje, kdo co položil, aniž by se spoléhala na barvu. Kterákoli osoba může tah přeskočit a jeden krok lze vzít zpět. Nic se neměří časem, nebere se do skóre ani neukládá. Tlačítko „Vytisknout tabuli“ vytiskne prázdnou tabuli a obrázky k vystřižení.
howTo: Klepněte na výstřižek v zásobníku. Dokud je vybraný, zobrazuje se „Vybráno“.
Klepněte na prázdné místo na tabuli. Výstřižek se tam položí a tah přejde na druhého.
Kdykoli může kterákoli osoba klepnout na Přeskočit, nebo na „Vrátit poslední kus“ a vzít zpět jeden krok.
Klepněte na „Další sada obrázků“ pro jiný zásobník. Obrázky už položené na tabuli zůstanou na místě.
Klepněte na „Začít znovu“ a tabuli vyprázdníte. Pokud si to rozmyslíte, použijte „Vrátit zpět“.
tips: Říkejte název každého obrázku, když ho položíte, například „šálek čaje jde ke domu“. Mluvení z toho dělá společnou činnost.
Nechte oba střídavě vybírat výstřižek i místo, aby měl každý co říct.
Na papíře vystřihněte osm obrázků s pomocí dospělého a pak je položte na vytištěná políčka.

faq.q: Je tu časovač, skóre nebo vítěz?
faq.a: Ne. Nic se neměří časem, nebere se do skóre ani nepočítá a nikdo nevyhrává. Plná tabule je prostě taková, na jejímž každém místě leží obrázek.

faq.q: Ukládají se nebo odesílají obrázky, které položíme?
faq.a: Ne. Tabule zůstává jen na této stránce. Neukládá se, nenahrává se ani nepočítá a po zavření stránky zmizí.

faq.q: Jak poznáme, který obrázek je čí?
faq.a: Každá osoba má svůj tvar. Obrázky první osoby mají v rohu kruh, obrázky druhé osoby čtverec, a nad tabulí je zobrazeno jméno každé z nich.

garden-planner.name: Plánovač zahrady
garden-planner.seoTitle: Plánovač zahrady: Rozložte pozemek podle obrázků rostlin
garden-planner.h1: Plánovač zahrady: Vyberte obrázky a rozložte pozemek
garden-planner.description: Vyberte obrázky rostlin a zahradních věcí a umístěte je do dvanácti záhonů pozemku. Klepněte na obrázek a potom na záhon. Bez časomíry a skóre. Hra i tisk jsou zdarma.
garden-planner.short: Vyberte obrázky rostlin a rozložte pozemek o dvanácti záhonech.
garden-planner.intro: Vyberte obrázky ze zásobníku rostlin a zahradních věcí a potom klepněte na záhon, abyste každou položku umístili na místo. Pozemek má dvanáct záhonů a na jeden záhon patří jeden obrázek. Shrnutí slovy říká, co plán obsahuje, například „Váš plán má 3 slunečnice, 2 růže a 1 strom.“ Nic se neměří časem, nebere se do skóre ani neukládá a tahy se nestřídají. Jde o obrázkový plán, o kterém si můžete povídat, ne o radu, jak sázet. Tlačítko „Vytisknout plán“ vytiskne záhony s vybranými obrázky, prázdné záhony k kreslení a řádky na poznámky.

Chcete-li záhon změnit, vyberte jiný obrázek a klepněte na záhon. Chcete-li záhon vyprázdnit, klepněte na něj bez vybraného obrázku.
Klepněte na „Začít znovu“, čímž vyprázdníte všechny záhony, a na „Vrátit zpět“, pokud si to rozmyslíte.
Klepněte na „Vytisknout plán“ a získejte papírovou kopii pozemku a shrnutí.

coloring-wall.h1: Udonga Lokudweba Lweqembu: Isithombe Esikhulu Esisodwa, Sidwetshwe Ndawonye
coloring-wall.description: Phrinta isithombe esikhulu esisodwa emakhasini amaningi, ukuze umndeni, ikilasi noma indawo yokunakekela bahlobise udonga olulodwa ndawonye. Mahhala ukuphrinta. Akukho sikhathi noma amaphuzu.
coloring-wall.short: Phrinta isithombe esikhulu emakhasini ukuze abantu abaningi bakudwebe.
coloring-wall.intro: Khetha isithombe kumakhasi okudweba bese ukhetha udonga lwamakhasi angu-4, angu-6 noma angu-9. Phrinta udonga: ikhasi lokuqala likhombisa indlela yokulihlanganisa, futhi amanye amakhasi ngaminye yingxenye yalesi sithombe esisodwa esikhulu, kunombhalo onjengo-A1 ekhoneni lawo. Ngabe munye noma abaningi bayadweba amakhasi, ngemibala nendlela noma yiluphi uhlobo. Amakhasi abe esehlelwa ngokwamalebhuli awo abe esehlanganiswa ngethepu ngasemuva. Akukho okulinganiselwa ngesikhathi, okunikezwa amaphuzu noma okugcinwa.
howTo: Khetha isithombe, bese ukhetha ukuthi udonga lunamakhasi angaki.
Funda imephu esikrinini, ebonisa ukuthi ilebhuli ngalinye liya kuphi.
Thepha "Phrinta udonga" bese uphrinta wonke amakhasi.
Nikeza umuntu ngamunye ikhasi elingu-1 noma amaningi okudweba. Imibala nezindlela akudingeki zifane.
Hlela amakhasi ngokwamalebhuli awo, bese uwahlanganisa ngethepu ngasemuva.
tips: Nikeza amakhasi anemigqa elula labo abafuna umsebenzi ochwepheshe, namakhasi anemininingwane eminingi noma yimuphi ojabulela lawo.
Phakamisa udonga lapho bonke bekwazi ukubona khona, bese nixoxa ndawonye ngezingxenye zalo.
Khetha udonga oluncane etafuleni elincane, nolukhulu egumbini.

faq.q: Kukhona isikhathi, amaphuzu noma umdlali owiniwe?
faq.a: Cha. Akukho okulinganiselwa ngesikhathi, okunikezwa amaphuzu noma okubalwayo, futhi akukho owinayo. Udonga yisithombe esidwetshwe yiningi labantu.

faq.q: Amakhasi agcinwa noma athunyelwa noma yikuphi?
faq.a: Cha. Udonga lwenziwa kule khasi kuphela. Alugcinwa, alilayishwa noma libalwe, futhi linyamalala uma uvala ikhasi.
Cha. Wonke umuntu angasebenzisa noma yimiphi imibala nanoma yiluphi uhlobo. Amakhasi asahlanganyela abe yisithombe esisodwa.
Yebo. Udonga oluphrintiwe yiyo yonke imidlalo: ikhasi lokuqala elinezinyathelo nemephu, nekhasi elilodwa kwingxenye ngayinye yesithombe.
Yebo, ukhululekile, futhi akudingeki iakhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu efonini, ethebhulethini noma ekhompyutheni.

quiet-shapes.name: Umdlalo wezimo ozolile
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Umdlalo Wezimo Ozolile: Faka Izimo Esithombeni
quiet-shapes.h1: Umdlalo Wezimo Ozolile: Faka Izingcezu Esithombeni
quiet-shapes.description: Faka izimo ezilula emugqeni wendlu, wesikebhe, wenhlanzi nokunye okuningi. Thepha ingcezu, bese uthepha indawo enesimo esifanayo. Akukho sikhathi noma amaphuzu. Mahhala ukudlala nokuphrinta.
quiet-shapes.short: Faka izimo ezilula esithombeni, ngesivinini sakho.
quiet-shapes.intro: Umugqa wesithombe, njengendlu, isikebhe noma irokhethi, uhlukaniswe izindawo. Indawo ngayinye inengcezu yesimo esifanayo, unxantathu omkhulu noma omncane, isikwele, i-parallelogram noma i-rectangle. Thepha ingcezu, bese uthepha indawo yesimo esifanayo, bese iyafaka. Indawo iphendula ingcezu ngokwayo, ngakho akukho okudingeka ukudonsa noma ukujikeleza. Uma ingcezu inesimo esihlukile endaweni, ihlala esitsheni ngenothi emfushane. Akukho okulinganiselwa ngesikhathi noma okunikezwa amaphuzu, futhi akukho okugcinwayo noma okuthunyelwayo. "Phrinta lesi simo" iphrinta umugqa nezingcezu zawo ekhasini elilodwa ukuze udwebe noma usike.
howTo: Thepha ingcezu esitsheni. Ibonisa "Ikhethiwe" lapho ikhethiwe.
Thepha indawo esithombeni. Uma isimo sifana, ingcezu iyafaka lapho.
Uma kungafani, zama enye indawo. Ayikho into elahlekayo ngokuzama.
Thepha ingcezu esithombeni ukuze uyibuyisele esitsheni, noma sebenzisa "Qala kabusha" ukuze ubuyisele zonke.
Uma yonke indawo inengcezu yayo, isithombe siphelile. Thepha "Esinye isimo" ukuze uthole esisha, noma thepha Phumula ukuze umise.
tips: Vula imigqa yesiqondiso ukuze ubone isikhala ngasinye. Yivale uma ufuna umdlalo onzima kancane, lapho unomugqa wangaphandle kuphela ongakulandela.
Qala ngezimo ezinkulu, njengonxantathu abakhulu namarektangili. Izingcezu ezincane zivame ukufika ekugcineni.
Biza izimo ngokuzwakalayo njengoba uqhubeka: “unxantathu, isikwele, irektangili elide”. Ukukhuluma kungenza lo mdlalo ube umsebenzi wokubambisana.
Ephepheni, phenya izingcezu ngemibala emibili noma emithathu, noma uzinqume nomuntu omdala esiza.

faq.q: Kukhona isibali-sikhathi, amaphuzu noma inani lezinyathelo?
faq.a: Cha. Akukho okubalwa ngesikhathi, okubalwa noma okunikezwa amaphuzu. Isiqephu esingafaneleki asibekwa lapho, futhi ungayeka noma nini ufuna.

faq.q: Ingabe into esiyenzayo iyagcinwa noma ithunyelwe?
faq.a: Cha. Umdwebo uhlala kulolu khasi kuphela. Awugcinwa, awulayishwa noma ubalwe, futhi unyamalala uma uvala ikhasi.

faq.q: Ingabe izikhala zinkulu ngokwanele isandla esithuthumelayo noma isikrini esincane?
faq.a: Isibonelo sigoqwe sibe nkulu ngangokunokwenzeka kusikrini, futhi isikhala ngasinye yinkinobho ongayifinyelela ngomunwe noma ngokhiye we-Tab. Izingcezu esitsheni yizinkinobho ezinkulu zalelikhasi.

Yebo. “Phrinta lo mumo” iphrinta isithombe esisodwa ekhasini elilodwa: isibonelo nemigqa yesiqondiso, kanye nezingcezu ezidwetshwe ngobukhulu obufanayo ngasohlangothini. Phenya izingcezu, noma uzinqume zilingane. Umuntu omdala angakwenza ukunquma.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli se-web kufoni, ku-tablet noma kukhompyutha.

calm-breathing.name: Ukuphefumula okuthulile
calm-breathing.description: Ukuphumula okuthulile kokuphefumula ukwabelana: isiyingi esithambile siyakhula bese sincipha ukuphefumula kasithupha. Niyaqala, futhi ningama noma kunini.
calm-breathing.short: Isiyingi esihamba kancane ongaphefumula nasiso. Qalani futhi nime nxa nithanda.
calm-breathing.intro: Ngezinye izikhathi umsebenzi ongcono kakhulu wukuphumula okuthulile. Thintani “Qala”, bese niphefumula ngaphakathi njengoba isiyingi sikhula, nangaphandle njengoba sincipha. Khethani isivinini esihamba kancane noma esishesha. Akuyona indlela yokwelapha, kungumzuzu omnandi nje wokwabelana.
howTo: Hlalani kahle beceleni komunye nomunye.
Khethani isivinini: kancane noma kuthambile.
Thintani “Qala”. Phefumulani ngaphakathi ngenkathi isiyingi sikhula, nangaphandle ngenkathi sincipha.
Siyama ngokwaso ngemva kokuphefumula kasithupha, noma nithinte “Misa” noma nini.
tips: Bambanani ngezandla noma niphumuze isandla engalweni yomuntu uma lokho kuyamukeleka.
Ningaphoqi neze. Uma efisa ukubuka kuphela, kulungile.
Uma othile enezinkinga zokuphefumula, phefumulani ngokujwayelekile futhi nibuke nje isiyingi. Buzani udokotela nganoma yiziphi izinkathazo zokuphefumula.

faq.a: Cha. Kungukuphumula okulula, okuyikhetho kokuthula nenkampani. Akuyona indlela yokwelapha ukukhathazeka noma noma yiluphi isimo. Khulumani nodokotela ngezinkinga zezempilo.

faq.q: Ingabe isiyingi siyanyakaza ngaphandle kokuthi ngiqale?
faq.a: Cha. Akukho okunyakazayo kuze nithinte Qala, futhi siyama ngemva kokuphefumula kasithupha noma uma nithinta Misa. Uma idivayisi yenu isethelwe ukunciphisa ukunyakaza, amagama ayashintsha ngaphandle kokuthi isiyingi sikhule.
Yebo, iyamahhala, futhi akukho akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza ku-browser yewebhu efonini, kuthebhulethi noma ekhompyutheni.

story-chain.name: Iketanga lezindaba
story-chain.seoTitle: Iketanga Lezindaba: Umdlalo Wendaba Yesithombe Esabelwanayo
story-chain.h1: Iketanga Lezindaba: Landisa Indaba Isithombe Ngesithombe
story-chain.description: Uchungechunge lwezithombe luyakha ngesisodwa, futhi ngalunye lumuntu ushilo umusho ngokuzwakalayo mayelana nakho. Akukho okudingeka ukuthayiphwa, akukho mpendulo eyiyo. Kuyamahhala, kuthulile, akukho sibali-sikhathi namaphuzu.
story-chain.short: Engeza isithombe, bese ngalunye ushilo umusho, nishintshane.
story-chain.intro: Umdlalo uqala ngesithombe esisodwa bese uyakha iketanga sithombe ngesithombe. Ngalunye lumuntu ushilo umusho owodwa mayelana neketanga selikhona, ngokuzwakalayo, ngokushintshana. Umusho ungaba ngalokho obona kho, indawo ekukhumbuza yona, noma into ehlekisayo. Akukho okuthayiphwa, okurekhodwayo noma okugcinwayo, akukho mpendulo eyiyo, futhi noma ubani angadlula. Iketanga limi kumasithombe ayisishiyagalombili, bese ningaqala elisha.
howTo: Bhekani isithombe sokuqala ndawonye.
Nishintshane: ngalunye lumuntu ushilo umusho mayelana neketanga selikhona. Noma ubani angadlula.
Thinta “Engeza isithombe” ukubeka isithombe esilandelayo ekugcineni kweketanga.
Thinta “Susa okokugcina” uma ukhetha ukubuyela emuva ngesithombe esisodwa.
Uma iketanga selinezithombe ezisishiyagalombili, thinta “Qala iketanga elisha” ukuze uthole elisha, noma yeka nje.
tips: Okufushane kulungile: “Umuntu ubeke amanzi ukuze abile.” Lowo olandelayo uyaqhubeka, noma adlule.
Vumela izithombe ziholele. Akukho indaba ophoqelelwe ukuyifinyelela.
Yeka noma nini ufuna. Ukuyeka phakathi kuyindlela elungile yokuphetha.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho iwashi, amaphuzu, inani lezinyathelo noma ukulahlekelwa. Ungayeka noma nini, futhi ukuyeka phakathi kuyindlela elungile yokuphetha.
Cha. Imisho ikhulunywa ngokuzwakalayo, futhi ayithayiphwa, ayirekhodwa noma ithunyelwe noma yikuphi. Umdlalo ubonisa izithombe kuphela.

faq.q: Yini uma umuntu engafuni ukukhuluma lutho?
faq.a: Noma ubani angadlula, futhi olandelayo uyaqhubeka. Akekho ondingeka ukuthi abize noma akhumbule isithombe.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli se-web kufoni, ku-tablet noma kukhompyutha.

quiet-scene.name: Isithombe esithulile
quiet-scene.h1: Isithombe Esithulile: Isithombe Esisodwa Esinganyakazi Ngesikhathi
quiet-scene.description: Isithombe esisodwa esikhulu, esinganyakazi ngesikhathi, ngasinye sinomugqa omncane oluthambile ngaphansi kwaso. Cindezela “Isithombe esilandelayo” noma “Isithombe esedlule” uma usulungele. Akukho okunyakazayo noma okudlalayo ngokwawo, futhi akukho sibali-sikhathi namaphuzu. Kuyamahhala, akudingeki i-akhawunti.
quiet-scene.short: Bheka isithombe esisodwa ngesikhathi, ngesivinini sakho.
quiet-scene.intro: Isithombe esikhulu esisodwa sigcwalisa isikrini, nomugqa omfushane ngaphansi kwaso. Cindezela “Isithombe esilandelayo” noma “Isithombe esedlule” uma usulungele enye. Akukho okunyakazayo, okunyamalalayo noma okushintshayo ngokwawo, futhi akukho okubalwa ngesikhathi. Thinta “Isithombe esikhulu” ukuze ubonise isithombe kuphela, ukuze igumbi lonke libone kumabonakude.
howTo: Bhekani isithombe ndawonye.
Funda umugqa ongaphansi kwaso ngokuzwakalayo uma uthanda.
Cindezela “Isithombe esilandelayo” noma “Isithombe esedlule” uma usulungele.
Thinta “Isithombe esikhulu” ukubonisa isithombe kuphela, no-“Bonisa konke” ukubuyisa okunye.
Yeka noma nini ufuna ngo-“Sekwanele okwamanje”.
tips: Vumela umuntu akhethe ukuthi uqhubekele kuphi: linda aqaphele, bese ucindezela “Isithombe esilandelayo”.
Uma kuneqembu, sebenzisa “Isithombe esikhulu” ku-thelevishini noma kuskrini esikhulu, uhlale lapho bonke bekwazi ukubona khona.
Akukho indlela eyiyo yokubheka isithombe. Ukukhuluma nje ngaso kuyisenzo esiphelele.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho iwashi, amaphuzu, inani lezinyathelo noma ukulahlekelwa. Ungayeka noma nini, futhi ukuyeka phakathi kuyindlela elungile yokuphetha.
Cha. Akukho msindo, futhi akukho okunyakazayo, okunyamalalayo noma okushintshayo ngokwakho. Isithombe siyashintsha kuphela uma ucindezela inkinobho.
Nee. Lo ngumfanekiso wokubukisisa ndawonye esikrinini. Isithombe esiyintandokazi noma ikhadi lePosta etafuleni lenza into efanayo.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kubhulawuza wewebhu kufoni, ithebulethi noma ikhompyutha.

color-wash.name: Color wash
color-wash.seoTitle: Color Wash: Umbala Othambile Kuphephandaba Lonke
color-wash.h1: Color Wash: Pende Umbala Othambile Kuphephandaba Lonke
color-wash.description: Ibhulashi elithambile lipenda izingubo ezibanzi, ezibonakala ngaphansi kombala kuphephandaba elilodwa, ngemibala emine nobukhulu bebhulashi obubili. Ayikho indawo yokuphela, akukho amaphuzu namanye isikhathi. Kuyamahhala ukudlala, akudingeki i-akhawunti.
color-wash.short: Pende izingubo ezithambile zombala kuphephandaba, ngesivinini sakho.
color-wash.intro: Ikhasi elilodwa nebhulashi elithambile elilodwa. Khetha umbala kanye nobukhulu bebhulashi, bese udonsa phezu kwekhasi ukuze ufake ingubo yombala. Ikhasi alinayo indawo yokuphela: akukho okufanele uqedile, akukho isithombe okufanele usithole kahle, futhi akukho amaphuzu. Faka izingubo zombala ezingaka ongathanda, noma beka phansi ibhulashi ubheke nje. Ikhasi elisha lisula konke, futhi ukuthi Ubuyisele kubuyisa konke.
howTo: Khetha umbala. Umbala ngamunye unegama lawo elibhaliwe.
Khetha Obanzi noma Obanzi kakhulu. Obanzi kakhulu umboza ikhasi eningi ngokushaya ngakunye.
Donsa phezu kwekhasi ngomunwe, ngemouse noma ngepeni ukuze wenze ingubo yombala.
Noma sebenzisa izinkinobho ze-arrow ukuhambisa indilinga yebhulashi, kanye ne-Space ukubeka phansi noma ukuphakamisa ibhulashi.
Thepha "Ikhasi elisha" ukuze usule ikhasi, bese "Ubuyisele" uma ufuna izingubo zombala ezibuyele.
tips: Vumela omunye umuntu akhethe umbala wengubo elandelayo, nixoxe ngemibala njengoba iyafakwa.
Obanzi kakhulu kulula ukuqondisa ngesandla esinyakazayo, ngoba ibhulashi alidingi ukuba lincane kangako.
Akukho indlela eqondile yokupenda. Yeka noma nini ofuna, noma thepha "Kuqedile okwamanje".

faq.a: Cha. Ikhasi alinayo indawo yokuphela. Akukho okuqedwayo, okubalwayo, okulinganiselwayo isikhathi noma okuthola amaphuzu, futhi akukho umyalezo ocela ukuthi wenze okwengeziwe.
Cha. Akukho okugcinwayo, okuphrintwayo noma okuthunyelwayo noma kuphi. Izingubo zombala zihlala kulelikhasi uze uliyeke.

faq.q: Ngingasebenzisa lokhu ngaphandle kwe-mouse noma isikrini sokuthinta?
faq.a: Yebo. Uma ikhasiligxile, izinkinobho ze-arrow zihambisa indilinga yebhulashi, futhi inkinobho ye-Space ibeka phansi noma iphakamise ibhulashi. Isikrini sithi "Ibhulashi liphansi" noma "Ibhulashi liphezulu" njalo lapho kwenzeka.
Cha. I-watercolor ephepheni isicabango esifanayo, ibhulashi elimanzi nombala owodwa ngesikhathi, ngakho kuyisenzo esihlukile okungazama etafuleni.
Okuphuzi, okuwolintshi, okuluhlaza nokupepuli, imibala emine efanayo esetshenziswa kwamanye amadlalo ethu esithombe. Ngamunye unegama lawo elibhaliwe, futhi igama libonakala ngasemuva kokukhetha.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kubhulawuza wewebhu kufoni, ithebulethi noma ikhompyutha.
